purpose: Analytic first-layer conjugation audit for the 35 strict Frequency global-MLP checkpoints; no training or checkpoint mutation.

model_contract.unchanged: first-layer bias and every subsequent tensor

theory_guardrail.same_numerical_initialization: The same numerical W in two bases is not function matched because W Q x generally differs from W x.
theory_guardrail.function_matched_initialization: Conjugating only the first layer produces the identical function in exact arithmetic.
theory_guardrail.optimizer_scope: The construction proves hypothesis-class closure and function matching; it does not make coordinate-wise AdamW dynamics rotation invariant.

numeric_tolerances.policy: Predeclared float32 evaluation bounds; report observed absolute and relative maxima without threshold retuning.

mutation_policy: Read checkpoints only. Conjugated checkpoints are not persisted unless an explicit output root is supplied.
